## We’re here to help.

If you have questions about one of our products or policies, please send us an email at support@verticalinsure.com.

**If you’re a policyholder** and would like to view your policy information, file a claim, or update payment, please use the customer portal at [customers.verticalinsure.com](https://customers.verticalinsure.com/login). If you’re new to the portal, create an account using the email address where you received our confirmation email after purchase.

[Customer Portal](https://customers.verticalinsure.com/login)
